headline: 49ers 24-20 Rams: Goal-line stand seals Thursday Night Football thriller
whyCareReason: San Francisco claims sole possession of first place in the NFC West after withstanding Matthew Stafford's frantic late comeback drive in Santa Clara.
teaser: FINAL at Levi's Stadium: 49ers 24, Rams 20. Brock Purdy threw two touchdowns and Christian McCaffrey added the winning score before San Francisco's defense stood tall.
story:
Why this one matters: Thursday Night Football in Santa Clara delivered an instant classic as the San Francisco 49ers held off the Los Angeles Rams 24-20 to take control of the NFC West.

Brock Purdy was sharp from the outset, distributing 254 yards and two touchdown strikes to Deebo Samuel and George Kittle. When Christian McCaffrey plunged into the end zone from four yards out early in the fourth quarter, San Francisco seemed poised for a comfortable finish.

Yet Matthew Stafford and Kyren Williams engineered a fierce response, cutting the deficit to four points. With less than a minute remaining, the Rams drove to the 49ers' 7-yard line, but San Francisco's defensive front held firm on fourth-and-goal, knocking down Stafford's pass to seal the victory.
stakes: The 49ers improve to 3-1 and secure key head-to-head division tiebreakers; the Rams drop to 2-2.
rivalryAngle: Another bruising chapter in the California rivalry, settled by inches on fourth down in prime time.
